boundedZoningDedupeCandidate: SUPPORTED_FOR_TESTING_ONLY; preserve last ownership and first-key identity

findings.title: Small real membership overlap supports a bounded correctness candidate
findings.detail: Two globally duplicated cell keys per seed, all within same-edge same-side adjacent-ID pairs;5/6 repeated references inside4/4 lot arrays. Generation buffers an entire edge before regenLots commits claims. Cells are appended without uniqueness checks. No rank1 capacity benefit follows.

findings.title: First-winner dedupe would change stable lot keys
findings.detail: Later lots236(seed1337),64 and380(seed7) begin with an overlapping key. Removing later ownership changes _lotKey. Offline last-winner normalization preserves all first keys and current union; it removes excess earlier membership while agreeing with current claimed-map overwrite semantics. This is candidate direction only, not tested product acceptance.

findings.title: Unique raster count is not guaranteed by nominal dimensions
findings.detail: Seed1337 lot227 and seed7 lot200 have5 distinct keys for nominal6-cell residential-low lots. Dedupe cannot recover a missing distinct cell and should not silently delete or resize these lots. Keep this limitation separate from overlap correction.

findings.title: Public digest and topology scope remain narrower than builder wording
findings.detail: Only equality boolean is retained, not before/after digest strings. Compared projection is id/buildingId/edgeId/side/cells; geometry, class, all building state, economy and allocator are absent. Complete lot membership and observed class/depth slot strings are retained, but not every raw slot key, road curve or unclaimed painted-cell map. This supports quotient replay and membership audit, not independent geometric regeneration.

limits: No screenshots requested or inspected; no new live browser, source changes, build, rendering/performance, memory, gameplay or API/restage tests. All saved JSON arrays were traversed and checked offline.
Digest strings are computed in-page then discarded. Equality is a recorded boolean and source-reviewed projection comparison, not an independently recomputable saved before/after state.

diagnose() calls regenLots(), replacing lot objects/maps and advancing nextLot even when IDs/cells match. It is correctly isolated to disposable pages; it is not a pure getter or a general state-preservation contract.

Run quotient equality holds for both observed claim passes and per edge, not every possible road/order/sampling/class configuration. Short-run slots are included in remainder slots; they must not be added as independent recoverable capacity.

Slot strings contain class and available-depth counts, not each sampled raster key or full road/cell geometry. Full membership is retained for emitted lots only; complete raw topology is an overstatement.
Mixed edge/side totals count raw references, including within-lot duplicates; they are not distinct physical-cell counts. Global unique totals4882/5176 match R8t.

Offline last-winner normalization assumes the documented same-edge generation order for affected adjacent pairs; it does not execute or approve a product implementation. Current first-cell identity preservation must also be validated on load, repeated regen and additional layouts.
Nominal-area shortfall is already present in one lot per seed and does not alone prove wrong world-space dimensions. Membership-only normalization should not claim to repair geometry or city density.

nextOwnerSafePriority.task: Test owner-local normalization of repeated cell references and same-edge overlap, preserving existing last-claim winner, all first keys, fixed geometric lot frames, IDs/building links and union. Reject changes to city/building/economy state beyond the intended corrected membership. Verify repeated regen, save/load/restage, two seeds and directed zoning boundaries; do not claim density or visual score progress.
